Maya: Quick heads-up 4 — our new Senior Infra ML starts Monday 9am PT. Need a slim week0 agenda + both a candidate one-pager and a manager-facing 30/60/90. Anita can you own?
Anita: Yep. Ill draft. Confirmed items: buddy, machine, and access?
Maya: Buddy is Carlos tentatively. IT says laptop can be imaged Friday if we confirm asset tag by EOD. VPN + Okta usually ready but please request GitHub org + repo write, GCP project viewer, and Redwood Console dev access.
Carlos: Ill be buddy mornings the first two weeks. Can set up 1010:30 daily syncs for pairing.
Anita: Proposed week0 agenda (short):
Mon AM  welcome, laptop/account handoff, intro to Slack + org chart
Mon PM  team demos (30m) + setup dev env pairing
Tue  codebase walkthrough + first tiny task assignment (pairing)
Wed  infra runbook, observability (Grafana/Logs), security basics (NDA sign-off if needed)
Thu  deploy workflow walk-through + smoke run (canary flow)
Fri  30m manager sync, buddy retro, next milestone planning
Anita: Pre-provision checklist to IT/Infra: laptop image, Okta account, Slack invite, GitHub org membership, CI write, k8s namespace + service account (canary deploy role), read-only prod metrics + Grafana share, Redwood Console dev org.
Eve: Legal needs NDA signed before access to internal datasets. Can people-ops-bot flag NDA step in candidate email?
people-ops-bot: NDA requirement noted. Candidate email template will include NDA link.
Maya: For the 30/60/90: two versions please - a candidate-facing one-pager (high level goals, contacts, what success looks like) and a manager-facing checklist (concrete deliverables + feedback cadence). Keep the candidate doc short.
Anita: Draft outline  Candidate one-pager highlights:
- 30d: env setup, 11 small PRs merged, understands main services
- 60d: owns a routine maintenance/deploy for a service, handles basic incident response playbook
- 90d: independent deploys, leads a tech discussion, measurable contribution tied to a service OKR
Anita: Manager-facing checkpoints (short list):
- Day0 confirm infra + accounts, welcome post in channel
- Week1 daily 15m check-ins, buddy pairing slots, assign 3 micro-tasks; end-of-week 30m review
- 30d two PRs merged, can run tests, buddy feedback collected
- 60d owns deploy for one non-peak window, demonstrates debugging steps in incident playbook
- 90d independent deploys + leads perf review, proposed improvements for latency/cost
Maya: Also include a "Manager quick tips" blurb: daily 15m standup, explicit acceptance criteria for micro-tasks, scheduled 1:1 at end of week, and mid-30d feedback checkpoint.
Carlos: I'll send calendar invites for pairing and set up a "buddy-reads" doc with quick links.
Eve: I'll gate dataset access on NDA; will coordinate with people-ops for the email.
Anita: I'll post draft candidate one-pager + manager 30/60/90 doc here later today for review. Tagging Carlos + Eve for access confirmations.
Maya: thank you. once Anita posts, I'll review and then hiring manager will send to candidate. :thumbsup:
